firstPlayerRule: The last person to dress up as a gangster takes the Boss token for the first round.
clarifications: Players select and reveal their gangster cards simultaneously; the Boss token assigns the opening role, not an exclusive first card play.
The Boss token passes clockwise after each round.

internalEvidence: Publisher-hosted English PDF was retrieved and both pages rendered and visually inspected. Codex editorial review under the owner's 2026-09-22 authorization: publisher PDF was reopened on 2026-09-24; page 2 assigns the Boss token to the person last dressed as a gangster, says all players choose and reveal simultaneously, and page 1 passes the token clockwise after a round. Public directory only: the criterion assigns a game-specific role rather than the first ordinary card play, so it is excluded from the random mix.
uncertainty: The opening Boss criterion has no stated tie-break.
The answer applies to the identified English publisher file; other editions may differ.
